datasets.title: Haiti - Damage Assessment in Les Anglais commune, South department as of 23 August 2021
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: EQ20210814HTI This map illustrates potentially damaged structures/buildings in Les Anglais Commune, South department of Haiti as detected by Pleiades image acquired on 23 August 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 3 damaged structures, 41 potentially damaged structures, 4 road obstacles and 8 landslide locations. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-les-anglais-commune-south-department-as-of-23-august-2021]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts reviewed Pleiades satellite imagery acquired on 23 August 2021 of Les Anglais commune, comparing pre- and post-earthquake images to identify structural damage, classify confidence levels, and detect secondary hazards including landslides and road obstacles. Results were compiled into geodatabase and shapefile formats for preliminary damage assessment following the 14 August 2021 Haiti earthquake.

sources.name: UN Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis using Pleiades imagery acquired 23 August 2021 to detect and classify earthquake-induced structural damage and secondary hazards through multi-temporal image comparison
